# Auto-trigger eval when λ=0.1 s2 training (PID 425058) completes

TRAIN_PID=425058
CHECKPOINT_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/a1_sdf_pi05_object_pudding/a1_sdf_pi05_object_pudding_seed2_l01/30000"
EVAL_GPU=0
EVAL_LOG="/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/eval_sdf_s2_l01_30k_auto.log"

echo "[$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')] Sentinel started. Watching training PID ${TRAIN_PID}..."
echo "[$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')] Checkpoint dir: ${CHECKPOINT_DIR}"

# Wait for training to finish
while kill -0 ${TRAIN_PID} 2>/dev/null; do
    sleep 60
done

echo "[$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')] Training PID ${TRAIN_PID} exited."

# Brief pause to ensure checkpoint is fully flushed to disk

    echo "[$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')] ERROR: model.safetensors not found at ${CHECKPOINT_DIR}"
    exit 1

echo "[$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')] Checkpoint verified: model.safetensors (${CKPT_SIZE} bytes)"
echo "[$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')] Starting eval on GPU ${EVAL_GPU}..."

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base
cd /root/colliforce-vla

python scripts/eval_safelibero.py \
    --checkpoint "${CHECKPOINT_DIR}" \
    --config_name pi05_libero \
    --model_type lora_baseline \
    --pi05 \
    --suite safelibero_object \
    --safety_level II \
    --n_episodes 50 \
